```{r}
## 1. 載入套件
packages <- c("car", "formattable", "fBasics", "dplyr", "tidyr", "ggplot2", "scales")
for (pkg in packages) {
  if (!require(pkg, character.only = TRUE)) {

    library(pkg, character.only = TRUE)
  }
}

df <- read.csv("flight_data_2024.csv",
               header = TRUE,
               stringsAsFactors = TRUE)
```

### 1 資料處理

```{r}
# ==============================================================================
# [1] 資料處理
# ==============================================================================
clean_and_engineer_features <- function(df, ref_top_origins = NULL, ref_top_dests = NULL) {

  cat("\n#### Processing Data: Cleaning & Feature Engineering ####\n")

  # --- 0. 設定參數與清單 ---
  holiday_list_2024 <- c(
    "2024-01-01", "2024-01-15", "2024-02-02", "2024-02-14", "2024-02-19",
    "2024-03-17", "2024-03-29", "2024-03-30", "2024-03-31", "2024-04-01",
    "2024-05-05", "2024-05-12", "2024-05-27", "2024-06-16", "2024-07-04",
    "2024-09-02", "2024-09-11", "2024-10-14", "2024-10-31", "2024-11-11",
    "2024-11-28", "2024-11-29", "2024-12-24", "2024-12-25", "2024-12-31"
  )

  # --- 1. 建立特徵 (Features) ---
  df <- df %>%
    mutate(
      is_delayed = if_else(dep_delay > 15, 1, 0),
      fl_date = as.Date(fl_date),
      holiday = if_else(fl_date %in% as.Date(holiday_list_2024) | day_of_week %in% c(6, 7), 1, 0),
      peak_time = if_else(
        (crs_dep_time >= 600  & crs_dep_time <= 859)  |
        (crs_dep_time >= 1000 & crs_dep_time <= 1159) |
        (crs_dep_time >= 1700 & crs_dep_time <= 1859),
        1, 0
      )
    )

  # --- 2. 排除取消與轉降 (Filtering) ---
  initial_rows <- nrow(df)
  df_clean <- df %>% filter(cancelled == 0, diverted == 0)
  cat(sprintf("Excluded cancelled/diverted. Rows: %d -> %d\n", initial_rows, nrow(df_clean)))

  # --- 3. 數值變數變換 ---
  df_clean <- df_clean %>%
    mutate(
      log_dep_delay = log(dep_delay + 100),
      log_distance  = log(distance + 1),
      log_air_time  = log(air_time + 1)
    )

  # --- 4. 類別變數整併 (Lumping) - 關鍵修改 ---

  # (A) Origin 處理
  if(is.null(ref_top_origins)) {
    cat("Calculating Top 20 Origins (Training Mode)...\n")
    top_origins <- names(sort(table(df_clean$origin), decreasing=T))[1:20]
  } else {
    cat("Using Provided Top 20 Origins (Validation Mode)...\n")
    top_origins <- ref_top_origins
  }

  # (B) Dest 處理
  if(is.null(ref_top_dests)) {
    cat("Calculating Top 20 Dests (Training Mode)...\n")
    top_dests <- names(sort(table(df_clean$dest), decreasing=T))[1:20]
  } else {
    cat("Using Provided Top 20 Dests (Validation Mode)...\n")
    top_dests <- ref_top_dests
  }

  # 應用 Top 20
  df_clean$origin_grp <- factor(ifelse(df_clean$origin %in% top_origins, as.character(df_clean$origin), "Other"),
                                levels = c(top_origins, "Other"))

  df_clean$dest_grp <- factor(ifelse(df_clean$dest %in% top_dests, as.character(df_clean$dest), "Other"),
                              levels = c(top_dests, "Other"))

  # --- 5. 時間變數分箱 (Binning) ---
  df_clean$time_block <- cut(df_clean$crs_dep_time,
                             breaks = c(0, 600, 1200, 1800, 2400),
                             labels = c("Night", "Morning", "Afternoon", "Evening"),
                             include.lowest = TRUE)

  # --- 6. 建立建模資料集 (Subsetting) ---
  modeling_vars <- c(
    "is_delayed", "log_distance", "log_air_time",
    "op_unique_carrier", "origin_grp", "dest_grp",
    "time_block", "month", "day_of_week", "holiday", "peak_time"
  )

  existing_vars <- modeling_vars[modeling_vars %in% names(df_clean)]
  df_model_full <- df_clean[, existing_vars]

  # --- 7. 建模資料轉型 (Factor Conversion) ---
  cat_vars <- c("op_unique_carrier", "origin_grp", "dest_grp", "time_block", "month", "day_of_week")
  for(v in cat_vars) {
    if(v %in% names(df_model_full)) {
      df_model_full[[v]] <- as.factor(df_model_full[[v]])
    }
  }

  cat("Processing Complete.\n")

  # --- 8. 回傳 List ---
  return(list(
    df_clean = df_clean,           # 完整資料
    df_model_full = df_model_full, # 建模用資料
    top_origins = top_origins,     # 算出來的(或沿用的) Top 20 Origin
    top_dests = top_dests          # 算出來的(或沿用的) Top 20 Dest
  ))
}
```

### 2 EDA

```{r}
# ==============================================================================
# [2] EDA
# ==============================================================================

# 0. 相關係數列表 & 散佈圖
cat("\n#### [Step 4] Bivariate Analysis (Y vs All X) ####\n")

# -------------------------------------------------------
# 0. 前置設定 (確保欄位存在)
# -------------------------------------------------------

# (a) 設定資料來源：使用清洗後的 df_clean
target_df <- df_clean
y_var_name <- "dep_delay"  # 設定目標變數

# (b) 確保 Y 存在
if (!y_var_name %in% names(target_df)) {
  stop("錯誤：資料中找不到 'dep_delay' 欄位，請確認 df_clean 是否正確。")
}

# (c) 定義要分析的 X (數值變數)
wanted_nums <- c("weather_delay", "carrier_delay", "late_aircraft_delay",
                 "nas_delay", "security_delay", "distance", "air_time",
                 "crs_dep_time", "dep_time", "arr_delay", "wheels_off", "taxi_out")
vars_num <- intersect(wanted_nums, names(target_df))

# (d) 定義要分析的 X (類別變數)
vars_cat <- names(target_df)[sapply(target_df, function(x) is.factor(x) || is.character(x))]
vars_cat <- setdiff(vars_cat, c("fl_date", "tail_num"))

cat("分析目標 Y:", y_var_name, "\n")

# -------------------------------------------------------
# 1. 執行分析
# -------------------------------------------------------

Y <- target_df[[y_var_name]]

if (is.numeric(Y)) {

  # 排除 Y 自己
  x_nums_only <- setdiff(vars_num, y_var_name)
  x_cats_only <- setdiff(vars_cat, y_var_name)

  # -------------------------------------------------------
  # 3.1 數值 X vs 數值 Y (Correlation List + Scatterplot)
  # -------------------------------------------------------
  if (length(x_nums_only) > 0) {

    cat("\n== Correlation Coefficients (Sorted by Strength with Y) ==\n")

    # 1. 計算相關係數 (只計算 X 與 Y 的關係，不看 X 與 X)
    cor_vals <- cor(target_df[, x_nums_only], Y, use = "pairwise.complete.obs")

    # 2. 整理成漂亮的表格
    cor_table <- data.frame(
      Variable = rownames(cor_vals),
      Correlation = as.numeric(cor_vals)
    )

    # 3. 排序 (由高到低)
    cor_table <- cor_table[order(cor_table$Correlation, decreasing = TRUE), ]

    # 4. 印出列表 (不印矩陣)
    print(cor_table, row.names = FALSE)

    cat("\n-- Plotting Scatterplots (Check Plots Pane) --\n")

    # 繪製散佈圖 (加上趨勢線)
    for (v in x_nums_only) {
      plot(target_df[[v]], Y, main = paste(y_var_name, "vs", v),
           xlab = v, ylab = y_var_name,
           pch = 16, col = rgb(0,0,0,0.2), cex=0.6)

      abline(lm(Y ~ target_df[[v]]), col = "red", lwd = 2)
    }
  }

  # -------------------------------------------------------
  # 3.2 類別 X vs 數值 Y (Boxplots)
  # -------------------------------------------------------
  if (length(x_cats_only) > 0) {
    cat("\n-- Plotting Boxplots (Check Plots Pane) --\n")

    for (v in x_cats_only) {
      # 依中位數排序
      mu <- tapply(Y, target_df[[v]], median, na.rm=TRUE)
      if (all(is.na(mu))) next
      mu[is.na(mu)] <- 0
      ord_labels <- names(sort(mu, decreasing=TRUE))

      # 若類別太多只取前 20
      if (length(ord_labels) > 20) ord_labels <- ord_labels[1:20]

      # 繪圖
      sub_df <- target_df %>% filter(.data[[v]] %in% ord_labels)
      sub_df[[v]] <- factor(sub_df[[v]], levels = ord_labels)

      boxplot(sub_df[[y_var_name]] ~ sub_df[[v]],
              main = paste(y_var_name, "by", v),
              xlab = "", ylab = y_var_name,
              las = 2, col = "lightyellow")
    }
  }

} else {
  cat("\n[Info] Y 為類別變數，跳過數值型雙變數繪圖。\n")
}

par(mfrow = c(1, 1))
```

```{r}
# 0. 班機延誤狀況
plot_data <- df_clean %>%
  group_by(is_delayed) %>%
  summarise(Count = n()) %>%
  mutate(
    Percentage = Count / sum(Count),
    Label = paste0(round(Percentage * 100, 1), "%")
  ) %>%
  mutate(Status = ifelse(is_delayed == 1, "Delayed", "On Time"))

ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = Status, y = Count, fill = Status)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", width = 0.6) +

  geom_text(aes(label = paste0(comma(Count), "\n(", Label, ")")),
            vjust = -0.5, size = 5, fontface = "bold") +

  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Delayed" = "#E74C3C",
                               "On Time" = "#2ECC71")) +

  scale_y_continuous(labels = comma, expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.15))) +

  labs(title = "Distribution of Flight Delays",

       y = "Number of Flights") +

  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 16),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.title.y = element_text(margin = margin(r = 10))
  )

# 延誤狀態 x（時段、星期、尖峰、假日）

draw_stack_plot <- function(data, x_var, title_text, x_axis_label = NULL) {
  if(is.null(x_axis_label)) x_axis_label <- x_var

  # 計算數量與百分比
  plot_df <- data %>%
    group_by(.data[[x_var]], Status) %>%
    summarise(Count = n(), .groups = 'drop_last') %>%
    mutate(
      Total = sum(Count),
      Pct = Count / Total,
      Label_Text = paste0(percent(Pct, accuracy = 0.1), "\n(", comma(Count), ")")
    ) %>%
    ungroup()

  # 畫圖
  p <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = factor(.data[[x_var]]), y = Count, fill = Status)) +
    geom_bar(stat = "identity", width = 0.65) +

    geom_text(aes(label = Label_Text),
              position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5),
              size = 3,
              color = "white",
              fontface = "bold",
              lineheight = 0.8) +

    scale_fill_manual(values = c("On-Time" = "#66CC66", "Delayed" = "#D9534F")) +

    labs(
      title = title_text,
      x = x_axis_label,
      y = "Number of Flights",
      fill = "Flight Status"
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = comma) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 14, face = "bold"),
      panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 10)
    )

  print(p)
}
```

```{r}
# 設定 Target Y
target_y <- "is_delayed"

# A. SLR 快速掃描 (在樣本上執行)
cat("\n#### [Step 3] Simple Linear Regression (SLR) Screening ####\n")

vars_num <- names(df_model)[sapply(df_model, is.numeric)]
vars_num <- setdiff(vars_num, target_y)

slr_results <- data.frame()

for (x in vars_num) {
  try({
    form <- as.formula(paste(target_y, "~", x))
    mod  <- lm(form, data = df_model)
    s    <- summary(mod)

    slr_results <- rbind(slr_results,
                         data.frame(Variable = x,
                                    Coefficient = coef(mod)[2],
                                    P_Value = s$coefficients[2, 4],
                                    R_Squared = s$r.squared))
  }, silent = TRUE)
}

if (nrow(slr_results) > 0) {
  slr_results <- slr_results[order(slr_results$R_Squared, decreasing = TRUE), ]
  cat("\n== SLR Results (Top 10) ==\n")
  print(format(head(slr_results, 10), digits=4))
}


# B. Full Model & VIF (在樣本上執行)
cat("\n#### [Step 4] Full Model Construction & VIF Check ####\n")

full_formula <- as.formula(paste(target_y, "~ . - log_air_time"))
#model_full <- lm(full_formula, data = df_model)
model_full <- glm(full_formula, family = binomial(link = "logit"), data = df_model) # GLM


cat("\n== Full Model Summary (Brief) ==\n")
cat("R-squared:", summary(model_full)$r.squared, "\n")
cat("Adj R-squared:", summary(model_full)$adj.r.squared, "\n")

cat("\n== VIF Check ==\n")
tryCatch({
  vif_vals <- vif(model_full)
  # 簡單顯示 VIF (若為 GVIF 則顯示最後一欄)
  if(is.matrix(vif_vals)) {
    print(vif_vals[, ncol(vif_vals)])
    cat("[Note] 數值為 GVIF^(1/(2*Df))。若 > 2 (相當於 VIF > 4) 需注意共線性。\n")
  } else {
    print(vif_vals)
    if(any(vif_vals > 10)) cat("[Warning] 有變數 VIF > 10！\n")
  }
}, error = function(e) {
  cat("[Skip] VIF 計算失敗 (可能存在完全共線)。\n")
})


# C. Stepwise Selection (AIC)
cat("\n#### [Step 5] Stepwise Selection (Backward by AIC) ####\n")

# D. 使用 backward selection (樣本數少，跑起來會快很多)
model_main <- step(model_full, direction = "backward", trace = 0)

cat("\n== Main Effects Model (After AIC Selection) ==\n")
print(summary(model_main)$call)
cat("AIC:", AIC(model_main), "\n")
cat("Variables retained:", paste(names(coef(model_main)), collapse=", "), "\n")

# 建立模型
model_main <- glm(
  is_delayed ~ log_distance + op_unique_carrier +
    origin_grp + dest_grp + time_block + month +
    day_of_week + holiday + peak_time,
  family = binomial(link = "logit"),
  data   = df_model
)

summary(model_main)

model_aic2 <- step(model_main, direction = "backward", trace = 1)
summary(model_aic2)
AIC(model_main, model_aic2)

# VIF / GVIF
v <- vif(model_main)
v
```

### 4 交互作用

```{r}
# ==============================================================================
# [4] 交互作用項
# ==============================================================================

## 加入想測試的交互作用
## 航司 x 距離, 航司 x 時段, 假日 x 航司, 尖峰時段 x 航司, 尖峰時段 x 假日
model_base <- model_main


## 航司 x 距離
model_int_dist <- update(
  model_base,
  . ~ . + log_distance:op_unique_carrier
)
anova_int_dist <- anova(model_base, model_int_dist, test = "Chisq")
AIC(model_base); AIC(model_int_dist) # 183504.8, 183425.5

## 航司 x 時段
model_int_time <- update(
  model_base,
  . ~ . + time_block:op_unique_carrier
)
anova_int_time <- anova(model_base, model_int_time, test = "Chisq")
AIC(model_base); AIC(model_int_time) # 183504.8, 182980.5

## 假日 x 航司
model_int_holiday <- update(
  model_base,
  . ~ . + holiday:op_unique_carrier
)
anova_int_holiday <- anova(model_base, model_int_holiday, test = "Chisq")
AIC(model_base); AIC(model_int_holiday) #183504.8, 183519.4 （不考慮加入)

## 尖峰時段 x 航司
model_int_peak <- update(
  model_base,
  . ~ . + peak_time:op_unique_carrier
)
anova_int_peak <- anova(model_base, model_int_peak, test = "Chisq")
AIC(model_base); AIC(model_int_peak) #183504.8, 183401.2
## 尖峰時段 x 假日
model_peak_holiday <- update(
  model_base,
  . ~ . + peak_time:holiday
)
anova_peak_holiday <- anova(model_base, model_peak_holiday , test = "Chisq")
AIC(model_base); AIC(model_peak_holiday ) #183504.8, 183506.7 （不考慮加入 可回答第三題)

## 從三個交互作用裡面選應該加入的變數
## 航司 x 距離, 航司 x 時段
model_dist_time <- update(
  model_base,
  . ~ . + log_distance:op_unique_carrier + time_block:op_unique_carrier
)
anova_dist_time <- anova(model_base, model_dist_time, test = "Chisq")
AIC(model_base); AIC(model_dist_time) #183504.8, 182889.6 (Best 選為最終模型)

## 航司 x 具題, 尖峰時段 x 航司
model_dist_peak <- update(
  model_base,
  . ~ . + log_distance:op_unique_carrier + peak_time:op_unique_carrier
)
anova_dist_peak <- anova(model_base, model_dist_peak, test = "Chisq")
AIC(model_base); AIC(model_dist_peak) #183504.8, 183320.7

## 時段 x 航司, 尖峰時段 x 航司
model_time_peak <- update(
  model_base,
  . ~ . + time_block:op_unique_carrier + peak_time:op_unique_carrier
)
anova_time_peak <- anova(model_base, model_time_peak, test = "Chisq")
AIC(model_base); AIC(model_time_peak) #183504.8, 182993.2

## 航司 x 時段, 假日 x 航司, 尖峰時段 x 航司
model_all <- update(
  model_base,
  . ~ . + time_block:op_unique_carrier + log_distance:op_unique_carrier + peak_time:op_unique_carrier
)
anova_all <- anova(model_base, model_all, test = "Chisq")
AIC(model_base); AIC(model_all) #183504.8, 182902.8

## 決定最終模型
model_final <- glm(
  is_delayed ~ log_distance + op_unique_carrier +
    origin_grp + dest_grp + time_block + month +
    day_of_week + holiday + peak_time +
    log_distance:op_unique_carrier +
    op_unique_carrier:time_block,
  family = binomial(link = "logit"),
  data   = df_model
)

summary(model_final)
```

### 5 模型檢驗

```{r}
# ==============================================================================
# [5] 模型檢驗
# ==============================================================================

# 1. Final Model Diagnostics
null_deviance  <- model_final$null.deviance # 196173.6
resid_deviance <- model_final$deviance # 182621.6
pseudo_R2_McF <- 1 - resid_deviance / null_deviance #  0.06908177


# 2. Overdispersion
pearson2 <- residuals(model_final, type = "pearson")
phi <- sum(pearson2^2) / model_final$df.residual
phi # 1.007402

# 3. Deviance goodness-of-fit
res_dev <- model_final$deviance
df_res  <- model_final$df.residual
p_gof   <- 1 - pchisq(res_dev, df_res)
p_gof  # = 1

# 4. Deviance residual vs fitted：
dev_res    <- residuals(model_final, type = "deviance")
fitted_val <- fitted(model_final)

plot(fitted_val, dev_res,
     xlab = "Fitted probabilities",
     ylab = "Deviance residuals",
     main = "Deviance residuals vs fitted")
abline(h = 0, lty = 2)

# 5. Cook's distance
plot(model_final, which = 4)

# 6. Null model vs final model 的 drop-in-deviance
model_null <- glm(is_delayed ~ 1,
                  family = binomial(link = "logit"),
                  data   = df_model)

anova(model_null, model_final, test = "Chisq")

# 7. 共線性
vif_vals <- vif(model_final)
vif_vals
if (is.matrix(vif_vals)) {
  gvif_adj <- vif_vals[, "GVIF^(1/(2*Df))"]
  gvif_adj
}
```

### 6 回答題目

```{r}
# ===========================================================================
# [6] 研究題目相關處理（Report 第四章）
# ===========================================================================

# 第一題

# 建立 Odds Ratio Table (OR_tab)
# 1. 提取係數與信賴區間
est <- coef(model_final)
se  <- summary(model_final)$coefficients[, 2]
p_val <- summary(model_final)$coefficients[, 4]

# 2. 計算 Odds Ratio (取 exponential)
or_res <- exp(est)
or_cil <- exp(est - 1.96 * se) # 95% 下界
or_ciu <- exp(est + 1.96 * se) # 95% 上界

# 3. 組合表格
OR_tab <- data.frame(
  OR      = or_res,
  OR_LCL  = or_cil,
  OR_UCL  = or_ciu,
  p_value = p_val
)

vars_RQ1 <- c(
  "log_distance",
  "holiday",
  "peak_time",
  "time_blockMorning",
  "time_blockAfternoon",
  "time_blockEvening"
)
OR_RQ1 <- OR_tab[vars_RQ1, ]
p <- OR_RQ1[, "p_value"]

sig <- ifelse(p < 0.001, "***",
              ifelse(p < 0.01,  "**",
                     ifelse(p < 0.05,  "*",
                            ifelse(p < 0.1,   ".",
                                   ""))))

OR_RQ1_star <- cbind(OR_RQ1, sig)
OR_RQ1_star
## 不同航空公司間延遲是否不同
## anova檢定
m_no_carrier <- update(model_final, . ~ . - op_unique_carrier)
anova(m_no_carrier, model_final, test = "Chisq") #顯著

## 列出前三家以及後三家
vars_air_main <- grep("^op_unique_carrier[^:]*$", rownames(OR_tab), value = TRUE)
OR_air_main <- OR_tab[vars_air_main, c("OR", "OR_LCL", "OR_UCL", "p_value")]
OR_air_main_sorted <- OR_air_main[order(OR_air_main[, "OR"]), ]
best3  <- head(OR_air_main_sorted, 3)
worst3 <- tail(OR_air_main_sorted, 3)
best3
worst3

## 設定控制其他變數的情境
carriers <- levels(df_model$op_unique_carrier) # 航空公司清單
median_log_distance <- median(df_model$log_distance, na.rm = TRUE) # 代表性距離：log_distance 中位數
base_origin_grp <- "Other" # 機場群組：先用 "Other" 作為代表
base_dest_grp   <- "Other" # 機場群組：先用 "Other" 作為代表
library(tidyr)
highrisk_scenarios <- expand.grid(
  op_unique_carrier = carriers,

) %>%
  mutate(
    log_distance = median_log_distance,
    origin_grp   = base_origin_grp,
    dest_grp     = base_dest_grp,
    month        = base_month,
    day_of_week  = base_dow,
    holiday      = 0,   # 平日情境
    peak_time    = 0    # 控制變數
  )

highrisk_scenarios <- highrisk_scenarios %>%
  mutate(
    op_unique_carrier = factor(op_unique_carrier,
                               levels = levels(df_model$op_unique_carrier)),
    time_block        = factor(time_block,
                               levels = levels(df_model$time_block)),
    origin_grp        = factor(origin_grp,
                               levels = levels(df_model$origin_grp)),
    dest_grp          = factor(dest_grp,
                               levels = levels(df_model$dest_grp)),
    month             = factor(month,
                               levels = levels(df_model$month)),
    day_of_week       = factor(day_of_week,
                               levels = levels(df_model$day_of_week))
  )

highrisk_scenarios$pred_delay <- predict(
  model_final,
  newdata = highrisk_scenarios,
  type    = "response"
)
carrier_peak_summary <- highrisk_scenarios %>%
  group_by(op_unique_carrier) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_peak = mean(pred_delay),  # 高風險時段的平均延誤風險（越低越好）
    sd_peak   = sd(pred_delay),    # Afternoon vs Evening 的變異（越小越穩定）
    max_peak  = max(pred_delay),   # 兩個裡面較差的那個時段
    min_peak  = min(pred_delay),   # 兩個裡面較好的那個時段
    .groups   = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(mean_peak, sd_peak)
head(carrier_peak_summary, 5) # 表現較佳、穩定的航司

  op_unique_carrier = carriers,
  scenario          = c("baseline", "congested"),

) %>%
  mutate(
    log_distance = median_log_distance,
    origin_grp   = base_origin_grp,

  )

  mutate(
    op_unique_carrier = factor(op_unique_carrier,
                               levels = levels(df_model$op_unique_carrier)),
    time_block        = factor(time_block,
                               levels = levels(df_model$time_block)),
    origin_grp        = factor(origin_grp,
                               levels = levels(df_model$origin_grp)),
    dest_grp          = factor(dest_grp,
                               levels = levels(df_model$dest_grp)),
    month             = factor(month,
                               levels = levels(df_model$month)),
    day_of_week       = factor(day_of_week,
                               levels = levels(df_model$day_of_week))
  )

## 模型算兩種情境的延誤機率
scen_all$pred <- predict(
  model_final,
  newdata = scen_all,
  type    = "response"
)

## 延誤敏感度 ranking
ranking <- scen_all %>%
  select(op_unique_carrier, scenario, pred) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from  = scenario,
    values_from = pred
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    sensitivity_abs = congested - baseline,  # 延誤機率增加多少 → 絕對敏感度
    sensitivity_rel = congested / baseline    # 延誤風險放大倍率 → 相對敏感度
  ) %>%
  arrange(sensitivity_abs)   # 感度越小越「撐得住壅塞」

ranking
```
